summary: A 1933 pole tower with 6x6 cab on Sycan Marsh's private ZX Ranch; a shared Fremont NF and Klamath Agency post from 1929, now private and closed to the public.

facts.status_note: Standing on private ranch land; the firelookout.com listing calls it abandoned, and the 2026 standing list shows it unmanned.

access.note: On private land; the register says the site is not accessible to the public, and the 2026 standing list marks it not accessible to the public.

visit.trail_note: Private ranch land; not open to visitors.

facts.agency: US Forest Service (Fremont National Forest), cooperating with the Klamath Indian Reservation

events.note: Cooperatively operated post run by the Fremont National Forest and the Klamath Indian Agency.
Klamath Agency declined to share the wages that season; the Fremont forest said it would staff the station itself.
Built as a 20-foot pole tower with a 6x6 cab.
Panorama photos taken at the lookout.
Registered on the National Historic Lookout Register as US 1647 on July 6, 2022.

evidence.supports: 1929 cooperative operation by the Fremont NF and the Klamath Indian Agency.
evidence.quote: 1929: The lookout was a cooperatively operated post by the Fremont National Forest and the Klamath Indian Agency.

evidence.supports: The Klamath Agency's 1930 decline to share wages, citing a road crew and a man on Yamsay.
evidence.quote: With a man on Yamsay and with a road crew working in the Sykan and Black Hills country

evidence.supports: The Fremont forest's 1930 reply that it would take care of the station itself.
evidence.quote: We have therefore made arrangements to take care of this station ourselves

evidence.supports: The lookout was constructed in 1933 as a 6x6 cab on an open pole tower.
evidence.quote: The lookout was constructed in 1933. The structure is a 6x6 cab on open pole tower.

evidence.supports: The tower is a 20-foot pole tower with a 6x6 cab, built 1933.
The firelookout.com listing calls the tower abandoned.
The site is private and not accessible to the public.
evidence.quote: The site is on private land and not accessible to the public.

evidence.supports: A 2008 photograph of the lookout is on the register page.
evidence.quote: Sycan Marsh (ZX Ranch) Lookout - 2008 - courtesy of Ron Kemnow

evidence.supports: The 2026 standing list shows the tower as unmanned and not accessible to the public.

corrections.why: The firelookout.com listing describes a 20-foot pole tower (about 6.1 m); no source gives 1.8 m, which looks like an error.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The firelookout.com listing calls the tower abandoned with no date; the register and the 2026 standing list show it still standing, on private land and closed to the public. The story reports it as standing and not open to visitors.
The 1929 cooperative post predates the 1933 tower; the sources do not say whether the tower replaced it.

notes_for_editor: Status and staffing rest on the register, an undated firelookout.com listing, and the July 2026 standing list. The brief's height_m of 1.8 is corrected to the 20-foot figure. Access is private: the story does not encourage any visit. The 2008 photo is listed on the register page; no image URL was captured, so no photo entry is included. The brief's access was 'unknown' and is now 'private'.
